messages.cli.s0002:
zcode {expression0}

Usage:
  zcode [command] [options]

With no command, zcode opens the full-screen TUI.

Commands:
  app-server Run the ZCode Protocol stdio app server
  commands   List custom slash commands ({protected0})
  doctor     Inspect runtime and packaging assumptions
  login [zai|bigmodel]  Sign in through browser authorization
  logout     Remove the shared Z.AI login credentials
  plugins    Manage plugins and marketplaces ({protected1}; alias: plugin)
  skills     List local skills ({protected2})
  tui        Open the terminal UI
  version    Print the CLI version

Options:
  -h, {protected3}       Show help
  -v, {protected4}    Show version
  -p, {protected5} <text>  Run a single prompt without opening the TUI
  {protected6}   With {protected7}, enable automatic Memory extraction and wait before exiting (requires Memory enabled)
  {protected8} <mode> Enable Browser Use backend (supported: headless)
  {protected9} <surface>  Presentation surface for headless prompts/app-server: terminal or desktop
  {protected10} <path> Chrome/Chromium executable for headless Browser Use
  {protected11} <path>  Attach a local file to {protected12}; repeat for multiple files
  {protected13} <path>     Run this command from the given directory
  {protected14}, {protected15} <tools...>
    Remove whole tools for this prompt/TUI run only; saved settings are unchanged.
    Comma or space-separated tool names, e.g. "Bash Edit".
    "Bash(git *)" removes all of Bash; command patterns are not matched.
  {protected16}      Force mid-conversation system projection for Anthropic providers
  {protected17} <locale>  UI locale: en-US, zh-CN, or auto
  {protected18} <mode>    Permission mode for prompts: build, edit, plan, or yolo (default: yolo for {protected19})
  {protected20} <sessionId>  Resume a persisted session by sessionId (sess_...)
  {protected21} <text>  Run or set the session goal in headless mode
  {protected22} Replace any existing session goal set by {protected23}
  -c, {protected24}        Resume the latest session for the current directory
  {protected25}           Print machine-readable JSON where supported
  {protected26}     Print the OAuth URL without opening a browser
  {protected27}       Disable ANSI colors
  {protected28}        Print extra diagnostic detail

Slash Commands:
  {protected29} [command]       Show slash command help
  {protected30}                Choose Z.AI or BigModel browser login
  {protected31}               Remove the shared Z.AI login credentials
  {protected32} [instructions]  Compact the current conversation
  {protected33} [status|resume|stop|<task>]  Run or manage the expert workflow
  {protected34} [list|cancel|resume]  List, cancel, or resume dynamic workflow runs
  {protected35} [latest|checkpointId]  Fork a new session from a workspace checkpoint
  {protected36} [list|status|connect|disconnect]  Show or manage MCP servers
  {protected37} [mode]          Show or switch permission mode: build, edit, plan, or yolo
  {protected38} [id]           Show or switch the current session model
  {protected39}                  Start a fresh session in the TUI
  {protected40} [sessionId]   Resume a session by sessionId; omit it for latest in cwd
  {protected41} [latest|checkpointId]  Show latest checkpoint or restore workspace files
  {protected42} [name] [task]  List skills, or force the next prompt to load one
  {protected43} [action]        Show or set the current session goal
